title: System Log: VoterTrack Backup Corruption

lines.msg: Failed to mount full backup image VTRK-BK-10282026.img (timestamp: 10/28/2026 02:00:00). Mount operation returned 'corrupted transaction log'.

File integrity check on VTRK-BK-10282026.img failed. Hash mismatch: expected 5c0e9a7d3f21b84e6a90c1d27f43b58e9a6d0c2f71b34e85a9d06c3f2e71b48a, got d1c4e2a5f7b3c8d1e6a9b2f0c3e4d5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2.
Transaction log in backup image shows uncommitted write sequence (0x00000001 to 0x00000005) with no corresponding commit record. Full restore blocked.
Forensic recovery required. Manual database restore not permitted under EOP 6.3. All user access to VoterTrack (LCBOE-VR01) remains blocked.

Backup was last verified on 10/28/2026 at 02:00:00 via air-gapped copy on LCBOE-PB01 (VTRK-BK-10282026). Verification hash matches clean export (LCBOE-PB01: SHA-256: 5c0e9a7d3f21b84e6a90c1d27f43b58e9a6d0c2f71b34e85a9d06c3f2e71b48a).
Full forensic recovery of VTRK-BK-10282026.img will take 2–3 hours. No user-level restoration is allowed until CISA forensic team validates integrity.
Integrity check initiated via COOP-DR-5 (evidence chain). All logs preserved in write-protected image (SHA-256: 5c0e9a7d3f21b84e6a90c1d27f43b58e9a6d0c2f71b34e85a9d06c3f2e71b48a).
